title: 7 Day Namibia Honeymoon Safari: Sossusvlei, Swakopmund and Etosha
rank_math_title: Namibia Honeymoon: 7 Days of Dunes, Coast and Etosha
rank_math_desc: Namibia honeymoon for 7 days: sunrise on the Sossusvlei dunes, two nights by the sea in Swakopmund and game drives in Etosha National Park.
post_content: This Namibia honeymoon gives you the country's most romantic settings in one week: starry desert nights at Sossus Dune Lodge right inside the Sesriem gate, two relaxed nights in the seaside town of Swakopmund at The Delight Swakopmund, and game drives in Etosha National Park from Mokuti Etosha Lodge.
overview:
This Namibia honeymoon gives you the country's most romantic settings in one week: starry desert nights at Sossus Dune Lodge right inside the Sesriem gate, two relaxed nights in the seaside town of Swakopmund at The Delight Swakopmund, and game drives in Etosha National Park from Mokuti Etosha Lodge. A private guide handles the driving so you can enjoy the views. It suits couples who want wide open spaces, photography and adventure rather than crowds.

Price: from USD 2,460 per adult sharing (low season estimate). Contact us for your exact dates.
highlights: Sunrise on the Sossusvlei dunes from Sossus Dune Lodge inside the park
Two nights by the Atlantic in Swakopmund
Optional dune, kayak or dolphin activities at Walvis Bay
Game drives in Etosha National Park

faq.q: How much does this Namibia honeymoon cost?
faq.a: It starts from USD 2,460 per adult sharing, based on low-season rates at the listed lodges. We confirm the price for your dates when you enquire.

faq.q: Is Namibia a good honeymoon destination?
faq.a: Yes. It is safe, uncrowded and very scenic, with some of the clearest night skies in the world.

faq.q: When is the best time for a Namibia honeymoon?
faq.a: April to October brings dry, sunny days and the best game viewing in Etosha.

featured_image.alt: Orange sand dune in the Namib Desert near Sossusvlei

itinerary.label: Day 1
itinerary.title: Windhoek to Sossusvlei
itinerary.content: Collection in Windhoek and drive to the Namib Desert. Sunset over the dunes. Dinner and overnight at Sossus Dune Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 2
itinerary.title: Sossusvlei and Deadvlei
itinerary.content: Enter the park at first light for the dunes and Deadvlei, then visit Sesriem Canyon. Dinner and overnight at Sossus Dune Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 3
itinerary.title: Sossusvlei to Swakopmund
itinerary.content: Drive through the desert via Solitaire and Walvis Bay to Swakopmund. Overnight at The Delight Swakopmund.

itinerary.label: Day 4
itinerary.title: Swakopmund
itinerary.content: Free day for optional activities such as a Walvis Bay dolphin cruise, kayaking or a living desert tour. Overnight at The Delight Swakopmund.

itinerary.label: Day 5
itinerary.title: Swakopmund to Etosha
itinerary.content: Drive north via Uis and Outjo to the eastern side of Etosha. Dinner and overnight at Mokuti Etosha Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 6
itinerary.title: Etosha National Park
itinerary.content: Full day of game drives between Etosha's waterholes. Dinner and overnight at Mokuti Etosha Lodge.

itinerary.label: Day 7
itinerary.title: Etosha to Windhoek
itinerary.content: Drive back to Windhoek for your onward flight.

includes: Accommodation and meals as listed (breakfast in Swakopmund, dinner bed and breakfast elsewhere)
excludes: International flights, visa and travel insurance
Tips for guides and camp staff
Drinks unless stated, laundry and personal expenses
